findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: Standard monthly prices: Lite USD10 and Pro USD50; three-month prices USD30 and USD150. No promotional or referral benefit enters the registry.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: October14 overview: Lite approximately 1900 invocations/5h, 12000/week, 24000/subscription-month; Pro5× approximately9500/60000/120000. All caps apply together. The explicit monthly cap must not be replaced by weekly ×52/12.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: One user prompt can trigger multiple model invocations. Quota depends on model, thinking, context, repository complexity, tools and auto-accept; prompts are not calls. Shared tool quota is not a fixed token allowance or an API-equivalent multiplier.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: Overview resets: five-hour window from first request; weekly Monday00:00; monthly first day of each subscription month00:00. Timezone is unstated. Region availability remains subject to the console.

FAQ estimates use dola-seed-2.0-lite with Claude Code and depend on model/context. This historical body was not independently recovered; latest retrieved overview differs. Do not combine the two quota sets or reset schedules.

findings.label: historical
findings.text: Supplied introductory Lite USD5/Pro USD25 and referral offer expired2026-09-30; excluded from standard prices and value. The current overview referral link has unresolved current terms; no referral assumption is made.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: Exact advertised aliases: dola-seed-2.0-pro, dola-seed-2.0-lite, dola-seed-2.0-code, bytedance-seed-code, glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.2, glm-5.1, kimi-k2.5, gpt-oss-120b, deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro. Support is advertised; regional availability can differ.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: Use is limited to supported coding tools. Anthropic coding base ends /api/coding; OpenAI coding base /api/coding/v3. Ordinary /api/v3 uses separate API billing. No endpoints, enrollment, purchases or consent are executed by this research.

findings.label: potential
findings.text: The pricing table separately lists glm-5-3-flash-260828, gpt-oss-120b-250805, deepseek-v4-1-flash-260910, deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813 and older deepseek-v4-pro-260425. These API versions do not prove Coding Plan alias-to-backend equality. Exact version, effort, quantization and route remain pending.

findings.label: potential
findings.text: Six fixed-snapshot opportunities counted once across Lite/Pro: GLM5.3Flash unspecified; gpt-oss-120b high; DeepSeekV4.1Flash non-reasoning/max; DeepSeekV4Pro0813 non-reasoning/max. Supplied research confirms V4.1 non-reasoning support but max remains uncertain; no dated backend or quantization equality follows. GLM alias support is not exact dated backend proof; V4Pro0813 is a potential version match.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: DeepSeekV4-Pro uses a higher quota deduction coefficient, but the retrieved overview does not specify a numeric coefficient. Do not invent it or reuse another model coefficient.

findings.label: potential
findings.text: No mapping to Flash Vision, non-Flash GLM5.3, KimiK3/K2.7, MiniMaxM3 or Qwen is established by these aliases. No similar identity borrows a score, effort, cost or factor.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.text: Linked ModelArk Data Authorization Agreement grants broad continuing rights for service/AI improvement, permits storage outside the service region, and says opt-out stops new content use while already authorized data cannot technically be deleted. Section3.2 excludes confidential/personal material and disclaims confidentiality duties for authorized data.

findings.label: potential
findings.text: Personal enrollment/terms linkage and any separate Team no-recording promise are not independently verified. Team claims cannot establish Personal handling or confidential suitability. Owner terms acceptance and confidential-use suitability are not assumed.

findings.label: potential
findings.text: No owner-accepted BytePlus factor exists. M equals same-workload API-equivalent spend divided by subscription spend. Price/quota alone cannot establish M; monthly caps, model mix, token/cache/thinking rates and actual applicable use are required. Missing evidence retains API-only cost and value.
